title: Syntagma sacrae theologiae (Liber II Cap. 3 densify complete)
author: Ludwig Crocius
edition: Syntagma sacrae theologiae (Bremen: Berthold Villerian, 1636). VD17 14:684303C. SLUB id335860389. Liber II Cap. 3 De animae immortalitate ex confessione optimorum philosophorum & rationibus COMPLETE (mid PHYS 345-mid-354 before CAPUT QUARTUM).
blurb: Ludwig Crocius — Book II Chapter 3 On the immortality of the soul from the confession of the best philosophers and from reasons, from the 1636 Bremen Latin. Densify COMPLETE (mid PHYS 345–mid-354): Cap. 3 title; not-best philosophers who deny (Epicurus, Lucretius, Dicaearchus, Stoics, Pliny, Averroes, Galen); Scripture-knowers who deny (Sadducees, Arabians, John XXIII, Photinians); Pherecydes/Pythagoras/Druids/Brahmans/Pharisees; Plato and Aristotle; Cicero and Seneca; four reasons (intellect, will, rest, inconveniences) and Wisdom 2; use — Cap. 3 close. Cap. 4 starts mid PHYS 354. Liber I Cap.1–11 and Liber II Cap.1–2 COMPLETE (english not modified).
era_note: Crocius wrote in the early seventeenth century as Reformed professor at Bremen. Public-domain Latin Reformed retrieval. The 1636 Villerian folio is Public Domain Mark 1.0 via SLUB Dresden.
cap4_start: mid PHYS 354 CAPUT QUARTUM / De animae immortalitate e perspicuis scripturae testimoniis
